topic: Troubleshooting data query in traffic tab
summary_markdown: A user reported an inability to retrieve data from the 'traffic' tab using specific criteria: Network (with sensors), City (Sao Paulo), Date Range (5 Nov 2023 to 7 Jan 2024), and Time Granulation (Week or Day). Multiple attempts, including variations in dates/granularity and testing on different machines, failed. Later, someone confirmed that the issue was related to a potential system failure around November 19-20.
decisions: The data query issue is suspected to be due to a recent system malfunction.
action_items: Someone will investigate the root cause of the data retrieval failure tomorrow.
